note: Values of the Mars place tools (assets-src/mars/place). oldLadder: the levels of main that the old land is read from.

dehaze.note: dehaze.py: the dark envelope of the place picture by distance from the twin and picture column; landKnee and landMost: the luminance of the land (scene) is bent over above landKnee and never passes landMost (what is brighter in the picture is taken as glow)

lead.note: lead.py: light is what the globe multiplies a lit level with near the ground at T (r g b, measured with flat.sh and light.py); the old land keeps its brightness and is moved by paletteMix to the hue of the picture's land (paletteHue, the median where the lay back leads at 1.2 deg) inside paletteCoreDeg, fading out to paletteEndDeg; paletteMix is 0 since the eighth bake (it was 0.85 and made a grey disc of 8 degrees on the red land): the hue of the land goes to the picture's by height, with the tint of src/stops/mars/near.json, which bake.py and topdown.py read through geom.near_tint

force.note: force.py: pictureStep is the grid of the twin's picture the comparison runs on (picture px), blurPx the blur of the difference (picture px), share how much of it is added, directFrom to directTo the stretch (plate texels per picture px) over which the lay back itself stops being used; spreadDeg is how far outside the fan the difference fades out (degrees on the ground), spreadShare its share at the edge, spreadBlurPx the blur of the spread field (plate px); edgePx the feather of the fan edge on the plate (plate px); calmShare how far the broad colour of the far fan (seen, but through thick haze) is brought to the land around it, calmBlurDeg the blur of that comparison (degrees), calmLeast and calmMost the limits of the ratio; groundBlur: the difference is blurred on the ground with a radius of blurPx x stretch x groundBlur plate px; calmHue how far the far fan takes the hue of the land around; outside the fan the broad tone of the take (blur of toneBlur of the plate width) is brought by a gain (toneLeast to toneMost) to the tone at the nearest edge of the fan, fading over spreadDeg; holdFromDeg to holdToDeg: the ground one picture px covers along the view (degrees) over which the hold and the sharp lay back fall away, about 0.33 to 0.5 degrees from the twin's foot (cliff faces laid back over the land behind them read from above as strokes that run out from the twin); beyond it only the broad tone of the picture is held, the difference blurred round on the ground over broadDeg and applied as a gain on the take between broadLeast and broadMost (texel values; as a sum the hazy far ground of the picture turned the take grey white); broadHue: how far the hue of that broad tone goes to the picture's (the limits broadLeast and broadMost hold for its lightness only); broadDetail: the power on the fine drawing of the take beyond the hold (its ratio to its own broad tone; 1 keeps it, 0 leaves only the broad tone), broadColour: the share of the fine colour kept there (0: the fine drawing is light and dark only); nearDeg: outside the fan the tone follows the held near ground of the picture within this distance of it (degrees), beyond it the tone of the nearest edge of the fan; toneShade: where that gain darkens, the shaded ground takes more of it than the lit ground (0: all alike); edgeWander: the edge of the fan is drawn back from the straight edge of the picture's field by up to this share of the plate width, far where the take is bright at that scale, so it runs along forms of the land; grainFromDeg to grainToDeg: the distance from the fan (degrees) over which the ground outside it takes the grain of the fan (the shade weight falls away and the fine contrast of the take, over grainBlur of the plate width, is brought to that of the fan at the nearest edge, never below grainLeast of its own)

nest.note: nestbase.py: matchFloor by plate width (degrees): the share of the broad tone match to the plate above that holds over the whole nested take, not only at its rim. Measured on the fifth bake: the takes were 0.36 to 0.44 in red (texel values) with red over green 1.9 to 2.2 where the old land round the place is 0.26 to 0.30 with 2.6 to 2.75, so the place stood pale and grey in the globe from 34 to 11 degrees across (frames 2413 to 2426).

bake.note: bake.py: plates from the deepest up (look: the plate of force.py, empty for the toned old land), the new lit level, the lit levels above that take the difference, the options of the stop; matchBlur and matchReach (shares of the plate width): the broad difference to the plate above is added at the rim and fades out matchReach inside it; matchLeast and matchMost bound the gain of the rim match; lookKnee and lookMost: the luminance of a plate (look values) is bent over above lookKnee and never passes lookMost
bake.ladderNote: Eight levels: 96, 42, 19 lit (4096 px); 8.5 (3686), 3.8 (4096), 1.6 (3686), 0.7 (3277), 0.3 (2176; it was 3277 until the cap's heights were counted in the set's memory, G15) with their own light. Chosen with predict.py --minor on the paths of E3 (main 03510ddd): dive worst 0.0082, rise worst about 0.016 of ground pixels under 1.0 texels. The 8.5 level at 3686 px reads the same as at 4096 and frees 17 MB: the full set then stands near 1376 MB of 1400. Smaller 42 or 19 levels fail in the rise (0.042 at 2724, 0.035 at 2720). Nine levels with every density doubled would need 53 MB more than the set may use.

matte.note: matte.py (values in field px at scale 1 and in shares of the margin depth): formPx the blur against which the light and dark of the land is taken, smoothPx the blur of that difference, formShare how far a form moves the cut across the margin, rampIn the depth over which the forms come in from the frame's edge, cut and soft the level and half width of the cut; where dehaze.py's t (blurred) is under tFrom to tTo the picture is haze or sky and the matte is a ramp from airFrom to airTo of the depth; endFrom to endTo: the matte is 0 before the field's own edge

country.note: country.py: the heights of the country round the place, one plate per level of the globe's ladder, coarse to fine. size: texels along a side. picture: the plate as painted, whose light the made heights are read from. sunBearingDeg: where the light in the plates comes from, clockwise from north (fitted: 170 to 190). gainKm: km of height per unit of log brightness times degree (fitted on the seen ground: 76.4 on the 1.6 plate, 82.1 on 0.7). broadShare: waves longer than this share of the plate width are left to the coarser level. hold: how hard waves across the Sun are held down. joinShare: over this share of the width the made relief comes in beside seen ground. edgeShare: over this share of the width at its border a level is the coarser level itself (the outermost: the smooth sphere). zeroShare: farther than this share of the width from seen ground the mesh has no say. stepKm, clear: made ground is lowered by stepKm a pass until it is clear (times the distance) behind what the picture's eye saw. broadMostDeg: the longest wave read from the light at any level (in a plate of 8.5 degrees the broad tone is colour of the land, not slope; with 0.15 of the width the made relief had an rms of 2.7 km and heights of -16 to +12 km). plateauKm: seen ground above this is the plateau, whose roughness the made ground takes, octave by octave (rough: least and most of the factor on the relief read from the light). canyon: the canyon carried on beyond what the close view saw, along the pale trough of the globe's own map (wrap-color) west of the spot, read off a grid of half degrees: axis in degrees east and north of the spot, from the fan's south west edge outward; floorKm its depth where it leaves the seen ground (the mesh floor is -6.3 to -7.0 km there), halfFloorDeg and wallDeg its cross section as measured on the mesh canyon (0.3 degrees rim to rim), fallFromDeg to fallToDeg the length along the axis over which the depth falls off to nothing. far: beyond fromDeg from the foot of the picture's eye the mesh heights are smoothed with a radius of perDeg times the distance beyond it (seen from above the far field of the close view is ridged along the eye's rays: a small error of distance along a ray is a long streak on the ground); the seen mask ends at fromDeg. roughFar, roughFarDeg: beside seen ground the made relief has the mesh plateau's roughness; over roughFarDeg (at most a quarter of the plate) it rises to roughFar of what the light reads with the fitted gain. The step of the lowering is never more than 1.2 texels of the level (steps of 50 m stood as terraces in the 0.3 plate). slopeMost: no slope of the heights is steeper than this (height over distance on the ground; ground.hold_slope): the mean of the highest ground under the heights and the lowest over them that keep the limit, so ground under the limit stays as it is and a wall becomes a slope centred on the wall; asked for by the cap of the globe, which draws a step between two texels as a curtain (steps of up to 87 texel widths stood in the first bake). zeroShare was 0.06 until the cap showed a dark foot along the straight north edge of the seen ground (the fall to the country's level took 0.042 degrees at the 0.7 plate); zeroWander: the distance wanders by amount about it, in cells of cellShare of the width. reliefSlope: the plateau is nearly flat (MAIL 449): no octave of the relief read from a plate's light is kept steeper than this (rms height times two pi over the wavelength); before it the made relief had an rms of 0.20 km at 3.8 degrees and read as dunes kilometres long. islandsFilled: ground the close view's mesh leaves open inside its own ground is filled by the membrane and not lowered under the eye's sight (it stood as a round pit at the head of the canyon). The pictures of the levels are the plates as bake.py lays them out (its work folder, lossless, before relight.py takes the slope light out of them): the set's own files no longer hold the painted light the relief is read from.

frame.note: The bearing of the place on the globe is one number, the plan's heading (src/stops/mars/plan.ts dive.headingDeg, read through geometry.json; MAIL 461 and 478: the place is turned about its vertical until the light of the approved close image falls on the globe's Sun). bearingDeg: the heading (degrees clockwise from north at the spot) for which the lines of this block marked as turning with the place (canyon.axis, canyon.east.axis, sunBearingDeg) and the takes of the four finer levels were made. The tools turn them by the difference (geom.turn_deg). Lines given on the globe's map (axisMap, trough) do not turn.

paint.note: paint.py: the colour of the carried on canyon, by code. tableDeg: the plate whose seen ground (laid back at true places) gives the table of colour over height and the cosine to the Sun; bins: heights by cosines; heightKm: range of the table; least: texels a bin needs; stretchMost: seen ground stretched more than this is left out of the table; slopeBlur: blur of the heights before the slope is taken, in texels of the table's plate (2048 a side); sunUp: height of the Sun over the ground as the third part of its direction; fromKm, toKm: depth of the canyon function over which the paint comes in; edgeDeg: soft edge against ground the picture saw; grainDeg, grain, grainMost: the fine drawing of the plate kept on the paint (blur, power, clamp).

border.note: the straight border of the picture's field on the ground: the made relief runs on across it and dies away inside over `share` of the plate width (at most mostDeg) times a seeded noise of cells of `cellShare` of the width; the seen mask ends where it starts

east.note: the canyon carried on east of the far end of the close view's meshes, the same function as the west one on its own line, laid along the canyon of the meshes (measured on the 3.8 level: deeper than 3.5 km from 0.05 to 0.23 degrees south at 0.5 east, from 0.11 to 0.32 south at 0.7 east; floor -5.2 to -5.9 km). The meshes close the canyon themselves far out: their floor is -4.2 km at 0.8 east and their ground is level (-0.3 km) at 0.9 east, which stood as a round pit with a round shadow. From takeFromDeg to takeToDeg from the eye's foot the mesh is lowered to this canyon where it is deeper. The depth dies away along the line from fallFromDeg to fallToDeg. Since the turn (MAIL 478) it keeps its depth to its mouth in the main trough (fallFromDeg and fallToDeg lie beyond its length).

gullies.note: spurs and gullies on the walls of the carried on canyon: the walls stand out and back by shiftDeg times a noise from a seeded table, short along the canyon (alongDeg a cell) and long across it (acrossDeg), three octaves with these shares

wander.note: the rims of the carried on canyon run in and out (width times e to the amount times a sum of sines along the length, one set of phases a side) and its floor rises and falls by the share `floor`

canyon.note: The carried on canyon. axis: behind the camera of the close view (it was west of the spot at the frame bearing), points in degrees east and north for the frame bearing, turned with the place. east: ahead of the camera, beyond the far end of the close view's meshes; its axis turns with the place as far as the finer takes show it (1.65 degrees) and is carried on by axisMap, points on the globe's map, into the main trough of the map, so that the image's canyon is a side canyon of the map's trough (MAIL 478).

light.note: relight.py (MAIL 449: the country is lit by the scene's Sun from its own heights, the plates become colour without slope light). The cap of the globe multiplies an own level by 1 + lift, lift = clamp((n.s - up) / max(up + wrap, 0.06), -0.85, 1.6) with n the normal of the heights, s the Sun, up = the Sun's height over level ground; wrap must equal light.wrap of src/stops/mars/look.ts. Made ground: the colour of the plate is split, in the log of scene values, into the colour of the region (the mean of the open made ground about a texel, regionDeg wide, at most regionShare of the plate), the middle waves and the fine grain (under fineTexels). The middle waves hold the plate's painted light: they stay by `keep` on level open ground, go to nothing where the heights stand steep (|lift| over steep) and in cast shadow, and never leave the region's colour by more than `darkest` down or `brightest` up (log units; a soft limit, tanh, since a hard one stood as two flat tones with sharp edges in the f4 stills), so no dark blot of a take stands as a pit. The hue of the middle waves (what is left of them without their luminance) stays by `hue`, at most hueMost. About the place the region's colour is `plateau`, the colour over 1 + lift of the level open plateau the close view saw (measured by this tool on the 1.6 and 3.8 levels: 0.134, 0.066, 0.043; the takes' own plateau stood at 0.57 of it on the 8.5, 3.8 and 1.6 levels and at 0.25 on 0.7), inside matchFromDeg of the spot, going over to the plate's own by matchToDeg: the made plateau and the seen one are one ground. The grain stays by `grain`, no further than grainMost (log units) from the region's colour and by the open share only (the grain of black paint is noise: it goes out between grainDarkTo and grainDarkFrom log units under the region's colour). Then the cast shadow of the heights is multiplied in: 1 in the open, `fill` (red, green, blue, scene values) in full shadow, with the half shade of a Sun sunSizeDeg wide, looked for over shadowKm toward the Sun in `steps` steps. In cast shadow the light is the sky's and has no slope toward the Sun, but the cap multiplies by 1 + lift there too: the fill is divided by 1 + lift of the heights (blurred by shadowLiftTexels, never under shadowLiftLeast), else ground that faces away from the Sun in shadow is darkened twice (measured in the f4 stills: canyon shadow at 0.105, 0.189, 0.257 of the plateau at 2452 against a fill of 0.196, 0.271, 0.355). fill is measured in references/approved/mars-close.jpg: shadowed wall over lit north wall 0.224, 0.318, 0.414; shadowed floor over lit north wall 0.168, 0.224, 0.295; the mean of the two. Ground the close view saw: the plate keeps the picture's own light and shadows and is divided by 1 + lift of its own heights, so that the cap's light gives the picture back. Since MAIL 461 the Sun of this step is the scene's own: the globe's Sun at the spot at the moment sunMoment of geometry.json (surface: the middle of the surface view, bearing 309.7, 22.4 degrees up), not the plates' painted light. troughKm: where the main trough of the map is this deep (km) the plate keeps the map's own paint as it is (no match to the plateau's colour, no rock colour, no flattening of its middle waves); only the cast shadow is laid on.

rock.note: the made canyon is rock and not the plateau's sand: under fromKm the colour of made ground goes over to rock, full at toKm (heights of the country in km). wall: the lit north wall of the approved close image (0.1135, 0.0747, 0.0593, scene values) over 1 + lift of a wall of 45 degrees facing the Sun (lift 1.0). floor: its shadowed floor near the eye (0.0190, 0.0168, 0.0175) over the fill. Level ground down there is floor, steep ground wall. strata: the wall's layers, a seeded noise over the height (bandsKm thick, with these shares, log units) that wanders with the place by wanderKm over cells of wanderDeg.

close.note: made ground about the spot takes the tone of the fore ground of the close view (the close view draws the ground its picture never saw, west of the spot and under the eye, as dark rock: 0.0157, 0.0096, 0.0082 in frame 2475 against 0.117, 0.044, 0.024 of the made plateau in 2474, linear picture values, a share of 0.135, 0.22, 0.34). gain: the share the made ground keeps inside fromDeg of the spot, going to 1 by toDeg (degrees on the ground).

preview.note: seecountry.py --shade, the preview OUT-lit.png only (no asset is made from it): the colour of the plates is multiplied in scene values by fill + (1 - fill) times the cosine to the Sun over that of level ground (at most `most`), zero in cast shadow.

reach.note: The ground about the place that the close view draws, by the eye's height (radii), highest first; read by the engine as a monotone curve over the log of the height, flat above the top knot and below the bottom one; written into country.json by countrybake.py. Measured on plan E's curve (agent/engine-handover 6d260fb; out/work/place/reach.py, reach2.py): a texel of the colour plates covers more than one film pixel (3840 wide) at the nearest ground in frame from 0.035 radii down in the ring beyond 0.70 degrees (plate 3.8, 54.9 m a texel), from 0.0145 in 0.31 to 0.70 (plate 1.6, 25.7 m), from 0.0066 in 0.13 to 0.31 (plate 0.7, 12.6 m), from 0.0026 inside 0.13 (plate 0.3, 5.4 m), and never more than 2.4 before T. The close view's ground is a sheet seen from the picture's eye; the angle at the ground between the film eye and that eye is 27 to 33 degrees at 0.035 radii, 21 to 23 at 0.0104, 16 to 19 at 0.0065, 4 to 6 at T in the dive, and in the rise 29 to 34 at 0.016, 18 to 21 at 0.0061. The seen ground reaches 0.70 degrees from the place.

lead.note: canyonlead.py: the shade of the heights laid on the painted canyon in the lead of a take. low, high: the gain where the ground faces away from the Sun and where it faces it (a level floor has the mean of the two); blurDeg: the heights are smoothed to this scale before the shade is taken.

craters.note: ground.craters: impact craters of the made plateau, by code, a function of the place alone (seeded list over a square of fieldDeg about the spot). perSquareDeg: craters of 1 km and more to a square degree; diameters from smallestKm to largestKm by a power law (the number larger than D falls as D to the minus power); depth, rim: bowl depth and rim height as shares of the diameter for a fresh crater, both less by up to `worn` with the crater's age (seeded); reach: the apron ends at this many radii; texels: a level holds the craters at least this many of its texels across; clear: a crater stands only if a ring of this many radii lies outside the canyon (canyon function above canyonKm) and off the ground the close view saw (mask of the outermost level widened by seenTexels). Why: the made plateau was wavy streaked relief read from the takes' light; the real plateau is nearly flat with craters and faint ridges (MAIL 449 item 3).

trough.note: The main trough of the globe's map south of the place, made real in the heights so that the side canyon opens into ground that is as deep as it is. Points in degrees east and north on the map (they do not turn). Measured on the 8.5 degree plate (the map's own ground at true places): north rim 1.95 degrees south at 1.7 west, 2.2 south at 1.7 east; black floor 2.7 to 3.4 south from 4 west to 1 east, 3.0 to 3.65 south at 3 east. The walls are long slopes (0.7 degrees for 5.6 km, about 7.5 degrees) without spurs of their own: the spurs are the map's paint, which the trough keeps (country.light.troughKm), so no wall is drawn twice. The level's border band takes the heights to zero toward the plate's border, as for all made ground.

fit.note: fitheights.py: the cap's heights fitted to the approved picture, a step on the plates of country.py. levels: the levels fitted (the 8.5 degree level keeps its bytes). toDeg, goneDeg: a texel the picture's eye saw takes the picture's own height out to toDeg from the eye's foot (country.far.fromDeg: beyond it the cap carries the canyon on and calms the far ground), gone by goneDeg (country.canyon.east.takeToDeg). joinTexels: the made ground beside follows through a membrane over this many texels. eyes: the lenses whose sight is kept free, first frame, last frame and step for the dive and the rise: the frame at which the surface view takes over, where the film shows the picture whole and nothing made may stand in front of it (a lens far from the picture's eye sees a rim hide the floor behind it, and that is true ground). every: every so many samples of the picture's distance files; cellPx: cells of a lens's frame, pixels of 1920 by 1080; grid: texels a side of the grid the lowering is found on; stepKm, passes, clear: as country.stepKm, the passes and country.clear of ground.lower_under_sight.

skirt.note: skirt.py: the made country beyond the close ground's footprint. insideDeg: the border is taken this far inside the laid footprint. openDeg: laid ground too narrow to hold a disc of this radius is not counted (blades). mirror: shares of the mirror at the nearest border point that are tried, first that falls on laid ground wins, else the border's own texel. holdDeg, reachDeg: the laid ground runs on to a line holdDeg + reachDeg x (1 + wander x field) from the border and ends over the last share soft of that way. toneDeg: the made country carries the broad tone of the laid ground at the border, which leaves over this far. wander: share by which the distances wander with the field. field: [cells across the 8.5 degree plate, weight] of the fixed field on the ground; seed. toneBlurDeg: the breadth the tone is measured over (laid texels only). gain: least and most of the tone's gain.

tone.note: platetone.py: the laid ground's brightness (scene value, Rec 709 weights) above knee goes to knee x (value / knee) ^ power. The made country's plain has a median near 0.06 to 0.075 and its brightest dunes 0.11.

under.note: landunder.py: the land levels take the forms of the map (patch-19) outside the place. keepDeg, fullDeg: the weight by the distance from the spot; broadTexels, fineTexels: the band of forms taken, in texels of the map; share: of the map forms; gain: bounds of the factor; plateauDeg, depthKm, besideDeg: the made canyon and the trough keep their own picture (ground lower than depthKm under the highest ground within plateauDeg, widened by besideDeg); aboveDeg: the lit levels above take the forms of the place out to here (fading from the first to the second)

reach.note: countrytake.py: the lay of the close ground holds within fromDeg of the spot and is gone beyond toDeg (degrees on the ground), the border wandering by wanderDeg along a fixed field of the ground (field: [size in degrees, share])

takes.note: countrytake.py: the country round the place from takes seen from straight above. levels: width in degrees to the take (assets-src/mars/place/takes, enlarged two times where the name ends in -x2). lay: false since the one ground (MAIL 837, MAIL 849): the plates of the takes hold the take alone at its own tone and no copy of the close picture, which lies on the ground through its own relief by the law of the stop (src/stops/mars/law.ts). With lay true the laid ground is kept as before (softDeg, inside, toneDeg, toneFull, gain and the block reach). Since the cap commit of the one ground a take gives up its own painted light (take_light of countrytake.py: its luminance held to the region's colour by country.light darkest and brightest, the cast shadow of the cap's heights laid in), and under the approved picture, where the cap's heights are the picture's own (block fit), it takes the picture's broad tone from the laid ground: the mean over toneTexels texels of the plate, by toneFull and gain as before, no stroke of the laid picture being that wide. toneGain: the least and the most of that tone's factor (the picture's shadowed floor stands at 0.17 to 0.3 of its lit wall, country.light.fill; the limit only keeps a ratio of two means of black paint from running away). brightest: how far a take's bright side may stand over its region (log units, soft; country.light.brightest holds made ground). regionMost: how far a take's region may stand over the plateau's own colour (country.light.plateau; log units, soft). Both because a take is painted in full Sun and the cap lights it again.
